summary: Iteration 15 - Settings & Workspace Management sprint. Backend: 19 pytest cases all pass (1 skipped: AI invoice generation), covering auth guards on all /api/settings*, GET /api/settings shape (5 sections + notifications), PATCH organization/branding/ai/documents/notifications with GET-verify persistence, PATCH /api/auth/profile, GET /api/settings/billing (plan Pro, seats, real usage counts), GET /api/settings/api-keys placeholder, GET /api/settings/recent-logins, GET /api/auth/sessions, fresh-user isolation (USD default, empty branding, own org name), POST /api/auth/change-password (old fails, new works), POST /api/auth/logout-all, POST /api/settings/upload-image, regression on dashboard/clients/projects/tasks/notifications/analytics/library. Frontend: All 10 tabs (settings-tab-general/organization/branding/ai/documents/notifications/security/apikeys/billing/integrations) render with correct panels. General save + reload persists firstName='Jordan', email is disabled. Organization VAT persisted on reload. Branding proposal footer persisted. AI temperature slider persisted at 0.3. Documents invoice prefix persisted. Notifications weeklyDigest toggle flipped from unchecked to checked and persisted on reload (single PATCH per toggle change). Billing panel shows Projects 3/100, Documents/Proposals/Contracts/Invoices real counts; upgrade-btn shows 'coming soon' toast. apikeys-create-btn disabled. Security panel has all inputs + logout-all-btn. Regression: dashboard/clients/projects/proposals/contracts/invoices/documents/analytics all load without error. Isolation E2E with fresh user: org name is their own, VAT/website empty, branding footers empty, billing usage all 0. logout-all-btn redirected to /login with success toast 'Signed out of all devices'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2018 lines - well past the 700-line ceiling. Split settings endpoints into /app/backend/routers/settings.py.

PATCH /api/settings/{branding,ai,documents} accept an unvalidated 'values: dict' payload with no Pydantic per-section schemas — clients can write arbitrary keys into settings.<section>.<any> in Mongo. Recommend defining BrandingUpdate / AISettingsUpdate / DocumentsUpdate / NotifPrefsUpdate models with explicit fields (like OrgProfileUpdate).
settingsApi.updateNotifications fires one PATCH per toggle click; rapid multi-toggle can race. Consider debouncing or a single Save button like other sections.
GET /api/settings/image/{asset_id} accepts token via ?auth= query — same token-in-URL concern noted in iteration 14 review. Prefer short-lived signed URL.
upload-image allows svg (XSS/script vector when served inline). Recommend sanitizing SVG or rejecting.

SelectField uses Radix Select (not native <select>) — good for design, but automated tests using select_option will fail. Not a bug, just a testability note; data-testid still works for open-and-click flow.

Notifications toggle PATCH does not return updated user profile — frontend relies on optimistic state; consider returning the merged prefs and updating context (currently GET /api/settings on next mount re-fetches so OK).
